name: EIA Grid Monitor and Hourly Electric Grid Data
known_limitations: Balancing-authority data helps characterize grid operations, but it does not by itself prove site-level interconnection capacity, deliverability, rate impacts, or utility service commitments.
automation_notes: Track balancing-authority demand, generation, interchange, and regional grid operating patterns for power constraint signals.
notes: First power-watch source for near-real-time grid operating context. Rechecked 2026-07-22: the EIA-930 monitor, downloads, and API remain active; hourly values are preliminary, can be revised or imputed, and do not establish project-level service or capacity.
